stem:
Charu makes a fuels chart for class. She lists coal, petroleum, natural gas, petrol, diesel, kerosene, CNG, LPG, wood, and dung cakes. Some autos run on CNG; her kitchen uses LPG.

Which claims correctly group these fuels? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Coal, petroleum, and natural gas are fossil fuels.
Petrol, diesel, and kerosene are obtained from petroleum.
Wood and dung cakes are fossil fuels because they burn for cooking.

teacher.key_rationale: Coal, petroleum, and natural gas are fossil fuels; petrol, diesel, and kerosene come from petroleum. Wood and dung cakes are not fossil fuels. CNG is compressed natural gas, not compressed LPG.
